First calendar year of independent Singapore coinage — two years after separation from Malaysia, new SGD small change in hawker / bus / shop tills. Country #42 — first Singapore in the vault; Southeast Asia after Vietnam / Philippines / Thailand. SER sibling: AS-SG-002. Singapore flips now 2.
